program.source: Fresh pre-turn RGB-D top samples and current proprioception; no hidden-object sensing.

clearance.scope: High diagnostic turn only; visible stationary scene assumption.

state.feature_source: GPT-authored program; not an independent sensor

x.instructions: For axis x, read state.processed_features.axes.x.goal_relation only. Choose positive for increase, negative for decrease, and hold for within_tolerance. Other axes do not determine this answer. Program-authored policy: For x, use state.processed_features.axes.x.goal_relation: increase means positive, decrease means negative, within_tolerance means hold. Correct only the supplied fixed-TCP diagnostic orientation. Do not infer scene clearance.

criteria.negative: Decrease this world coordinate or world rotation-vector component.
criteria.hold: Apply no component correction within tolerance.
criteria.positive: Increase this world coordinate or world rotation-vector component.

gripper.instructions: For the gripper question, read state.processed_features.objective.gripper and deliver that requirement. Program-authored policy: Use state.processed_features.objective.gripper. This diagnostic turn requires keep, preserving the existing open command. Neither closure nor a new opening is requested.

criteria.open: Deliver only an explicitly supplied open objective.
criteria.close: Deliver only an explicitly supplied close objective.
criteria.keep: Preserve the existing gripper command, as required here.
